svg.title: Real GitHub activity — monochrome contribution candles
svg.desc: 334 contributions in 365 observed days; 216 in the last 90. Daily candles: open is the previous trailing seven-day total; close is the current total. High and low are the larger and smaller endpoints, without invented intraday movement. Filled bodies rise, hollow bodies fall, lines are flat. Volume is each day’s actual count.
svg.text: FILLED: UP / HOLLOW: DOWN / LINE: FLAT
